items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: He used to come around where our band was... we heard he was violin playing... we tried to get him to work over the bar while we was working

ctx.x: Yeah it seems to me there was a clarinet player that was related to him or something. I got some sheet music. Yeah well we'll look at it. He had a band in Pensacola.

Yeah. Him and his brother, they had a band there. Well I guess all them fellas played together. He was a good violin player. He used to come around where our band was, you know, we had a little joint where we used to sit around there until it was time to go to work. We was working over the bar there. And he'd come in, you know, and we heard he was violin playing the news, gambling all the time, you know, and said, say, Pensacola, do you mind playing a little violin for us? He said, yeah I'd play for you but I…
What kind of ball was that?
